verdict.rationale: The Division of Revenue's public site documents online tools to check return and refund status, and a public Business Licenses Simple Search that can be used to look up licenses. But there is no detail on how these tools work, and the probe shows filings and registrations otherwise live behind an authenticated portal session. Missing for 10: documented public status lookup for business license applications or cases, details of the status-check tool itself (inputs, whether login is required), and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages

citations.quote: Check the status of your return and your refund using our online tools and services.
